13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">The licence provisions satisfy the preferred position in full. § 13.1 grants the access right directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf" (no written-notice precondition, so better than fallback); § 13.2 gives a "perpetual, irrevocable" fully paid licence to Customer and its Affiliates for paid-up software and Vendor Technology and expressly permits contractors to support that material; § 13.3 limits Vendor revocation/suspension to "a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure," so the subscription licence is not revocable at will; and § 13.3 with § 24.1 allows transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without Vendor consent, reinforced by § 24.4. The § 13.4 restrictions are narrow and expressly do not limit authorized testing or use of Customer Data and output, so they do not undercut agreed use. No redline required.
